async def act(page):
    # Fill the Project name textbox with the new title
    project_name_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    await project_name_textbox.fill('Title Wanted')
    
    # Wait a moment for UI updates
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Click the Save changes button within the same group as the Project name textbox
    save_button = page.get_by_role('group').filter(
        has=page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    ).get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to reload after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
